lc_person: Harry Roderick (H. R., Rod) Kedward, University of Sussex historian of modern France and the French Resistance; author of The Dreyfus Affair and Resistance in Vichy France.
item_person: Rod Kedward (1937–2023), historian affiliated with the University of Sussex, identified by LC n50046408, VIAF 2490502 and ISNI 0000000108626081.

evidence.says: The authorized heading is Kedward, H. R. (Harry Roderick), with variants Harry Roderick Kedward and Roderick Kedward. Sources include The Dreyfus affair (1965) and Resistance in Vichy France (1983, copyright 1978). Its 2022 source note identifies Harry Roderick, known as Rod, as a Sussex historian specializing in Vichy France and the French Resistance, born in 1937. The authority links Q7356262, VIAF 2490502 and ISNI 0000000108626081.

Q7356262 is labeled Rod Kedward and described as a historian. It records birth year 1937, death year 2023, University of Sussex employment, LC identifier n50046408, VIAF 2490502 and ISNI 0000000108626081; the identifiers agree with LC.
The graph’s Open Library author OL834136A has The Dreyfus affair and Resistance in Vichy France, matching the LC source works, as well as In search of the Maquis and La vie en bleu.

The History Department obituary identifies Rod Kedward as a Sussex historian who became Professor of European History in 1991. It names Resistance in Vichy France (1978), In Search of the Maquis (1993) and The French Resistance and Its Legacy (2022).
The obituary gives the full name Harry Roderick Kedward and birth year 1937.

notes: The name flag reflects the familiar name Rod versus the expanded LC heading. Matching works and identifiers establish the same person and support the graph key. LC has no birth year in its heading, but its source note supports Wikidata’s 1937. LC and Wikidata were read through their structured JSON representations.
